sources.observation: The western approach has pale fortified masonry, a low entrance, layered historical infills and a low roof silhouette.
Dark metal sheet courses define the nave roof above the pale clerestory and adjoining flat roofs.

limitations: The native plan fixes the church’s outline, west door and apses. Exterior heights, lead roof bays, masonry infills and carved details use approximate photo and PMTiles dimensions.
The model covers the basilica exterior and shallow entrance reveal. The Grotto, churches and adjacent convents remain distinct mapped places.
The west approach sets elevation from the available Terrarium samples. Surrounding hillside grades are approximate.
